sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('7646ca22-710e-4a5c-9613-b829e2f9d5ce', '3791d79c-d960-4790-b689-ea32ddf7226a') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment
